description:
Full Stack Developer 
 Location:  Hilton Head Island (You must live within a commutable distance of our offices)
 Salary : $70k base + $10k Bonus + Stock Options
 Term : Full-time, permanent
 Are you a full-stack developer with a Computer Science degree with some relevant work experience? Then The Anywhere Company might be a great fit for you. 
 Whether you’re a high-performing recent graduate, or an experience Developer, you will be part of our Research & Development team, building solutions that are used by Fortune-500 companies across the globe. This is a rapidly growing environment where you will be introduced to a range of different solutions and technology.
 Our R&D team is small enough that your input will be significant, but large enough that there will be support when you need it. We work as a team, helping each other and coming up with better solutions every day.
 We are looking for talented and self-motivated candidates who have the drive to push the company forward. We reward people for their hard work and professionalism.
 Desired Skills & Experience 
 Technical university degree from a top university
 A relevant internship or experience since graduating
 Experience with a mix: JavaScript, Java, SQL, HTML, CSS
 Fundamental knowledge of machine learning & AI
 Additional experience in any of the following a plus, but not a must:
 Object-orientated JavaScript, functional programming, AWS, JSP, MySQL or Aurora.
 Have good design awareness and knowledge of design patterns.
 Have the motivation to improve the software, but most importantly, yourself.
 About Us 
 The Anywhere Company, the creators of The Anywhere Company, develop beautifully uncomplicated software to manage process, people and financials. We combine clean design and cutting edge technology to create truly compelling solutions for global enterprises.
 We are a young company, full of experienced heads, looking for bright, self-reliant people who can demonstrate the right mix of leadership and technical excellence.
 We reward our people well including the chance to share in the ownership of the company. We also try to make it fun, with a great atmosphere and plenty of chances to get out of the office as a team every month.
